_about: Third-party components in VaultInk. Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/gen_licenses.py. It writes docs/licenses.md, src/util/ThirdPartyData.h and the component list in NOTICE. Every licence here was read from the file named in verified_from; A component with only_with is linked only into builds that set that flag; the device list leaves it out elsewhere. 'not verified' means no licence file or package metadata was available to read.

components.name: wolfSSL
components.verified_from: .pio/libdeps/x4pro/Arduino-wolfSSL/LICENSING, COPYING and the header of src/wolfssl/ssl.h
components.notes: Dual-licensed: GPL or a commercial licence from wolfSSL Inc. VaultInk uses it under the GPL. Its library.json says GPL-2.0-only; the LICENSING file and the source headers say version 2 or any later version. Source headers say version 2 or later, so it can be combined under GPL version 3, which the Apache-2.0 code in the binary needs.

components.name: wolfSSH
components.used_for: SSH terminal and SFTP client (X4 Pro)
components.verified_from: lib/wolfssh/LICENSING and the header of lib/wolfssh/src/ssh.c
components.notes: Dual-licensed: GPL or a commercial licence from wolfSSL Inc. VaultInk uses it under the GPL. LICENSING says GPLv3; the source headers say version 3 or any later version. Linked only into builds with VAULTINK_SSH=1 (the X4 Pro builds); with wolfSSL's 'version 2 or any later version' the two are combined under GPL-3.0-or-later, so those binaries are distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later. lib/wolfssh/UPSTREAM.md lists what was taken and the VaultInk build files added next to it. lib/wolfssh/COPYING is the GPL version 3 text (upstream ships none).
